main_text.p: מִשְׁלְבִין Ch. Graduati, instar graduum, scalari forma dispositi, Exod.26.17.&36.22.
שְׁלַבּוּקִין Ch. Pustulæ, Exo.9.9.in Targ.Hieros.In Targ. Jon.est ם in medio.
שְׁלַבֵּשׁ Pahel Ch. Conjungere, connectere, incastrare, Exod.26.28.&36.33.in Targ.Jonath.
שְׁלָא Syr. Truncus, cadaver, corpus examine, Matth.14.12.Act.9.40. Ch. בְּשְׁלָרְיָה In cadaver ejus, Jobi 20.23. Plur. const. שְׁלָרִיבְסְרִיָּה Costæ carnis ejus, Jobi 41.14.

שְׁלָה שְׁלִי Ch.& Syr. Quiescere, cessare, otiosum, tranquillum esse, silere, tacere. Hinc Græc. ἡσυχάζω: Item Ch. Errare, aberrare, ex errore vel ignorantia delinquere, peccare: Oblivisci, oblivioni tradere. Pahel Syr. שַׁלִּי Quiescere fecit, tranquillum reddidit, sedavit, Act.19.35.Ethp. Syr. Part. שַׁלִּין Non desino ego, ad Eph. 1.16.

Ithpeh. Ch. אִשְׁתַּלִי Erravit, aberravit, deliquit, peccavit: Oblivioni tradi: 2.Reg.11.6. וְתִשְׁתְּרוּן יַת מַטְרַת בֵּיתָא מְרַאשְׁתַּלִי Et custodietis custodiam domus, ne spernatur, ne contumelia ipsi inferatur: sic explicari poterit juxta sequentem significationem in Aphel, Hebr. מַסָּה Ab evulsione. Regia habent מִשְׁתַּרְלִי Sollicitè.
Aphel אַשְׁלִי Errare, aberrare facere, Jobi 12.16. Psal.119.10. Oblivisci, spernere, aspernari, rejicere, respuere, quomodo convenit cum אַסְלִי, per commutationem ם & ש, Prov.1.30.&5.12.Psal.44.10.
